title: Such a thoughtful gift from my husband
text: Such a thoughtful gift from my husband. This is so pretty. The mirrors inside are really nice, one is normal and the other is magnified. The picture shows you the size next to my Echo Dot. The compact is a little big and thick. But still a nice gift. I could easily check my lipstick or eye shadow with this.
